notes: EBIT is mapped to consolidated Operating income from Molina’s consolidated statements of income (2023–2025). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

D&A is mapped to consolidated Depreciation and amortization from the cash flow/financial statement presentation (2023–2025). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Capex is mapped to Purchases of property, equipment and capitalized software from the consolidated cash flow statement; output capex values are reported as absolute (positive) amounts. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

NWC is mapped to Molina’s reported consolidated working capital on a net basis from MD&A (Working capital on a consolidated basis). This may differ from a custom NWC definition that excludes cash/investments or includes/excludes statutory items. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Cash/debt: cash uses Cash and cash equivalents; investments uses Investments; debt uses Long-term debt. Finance lease liabilities are not included in the debt field. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))
Tax rate uses management’s guidance Effective Tax Rate for 2026 (30.0%) as the DCF tax_rate assumption. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))
Current price (139.41) is from the latest market snapshot available via the finance tool and may reflect the prior trading day relative to 2026-03-21.

NOL balance is mapped to the sum of state and foreign net operating loss carryforwards disclosed in the 2025 Form 10-K; NOL utilization percent is assumed at 0.80 per the modeling requirement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Peer multiples: EV/Sales and EV/EBITDA are treated as proxies for EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA because explicit NTM labeling was not available on the accessed peer pages; forward P/E is used where available. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/unh/statistics/))

Forecast margins and driver ratios are base-case assumptions (not direct line-item guidance) chosen to reflect a trough-to-recovery pattern consistent with 2026 guidance and recent historical profitability. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

catalysts: Execution of the Florida CMS Medicaid contract implementation and related margin recovery (timing and cost control versus trough assumptions). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Progress on Medicare Advantage Part D (MAPD) exit and related profitability improvement trajectory into 2027+. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Improvement in utilization / MCR versus 2025 outcomes, supporting operating margin recovery from the modeled trough. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))
company_overview: Molina Healthcare provides managed healthcare services across Medicaid, Medicare, and state marketplaces, operating primarily through wholly owned health plan subsidiaries. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

The company’s consolidated results are driven by premium revenue and medical cost trends, with profitability tightly linked to medical care ratio (MCR) dynamics. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Molina also maintains meaningful liquidity via cash and investment holdings and funds statutory capital requirements at the health plan level. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))
current_context: In its Feb 5, 2026 earnings release, Molina guided 2026 Total Revenue of $44.5B and Premium Revenue of ~$42.2B, reflecting a modest decline versus 2025 Total Revenue. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Guidance also indicates a trough-style margin environment: MCR of 92.6% and GAAP pre-tax margin of 0.5%, with Effective Tax Rate of 30.0%. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Management noted guidance pressure tied to Florida Medicaid contract implementation costs and underperformance in traditional Medicare Advantage Part D (MAPD), with MAPD exit for 2027. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is modestly negative in 2026 (consistent with company guidance), then turns positive as the operating platform benefits from expected normalization in the cycle and embedded earnings. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Base-case EBIT margin is set low for 2026 and recovers gradually through 2030, reflecting a normalization of medical cost trends and operating leverage once the trough passes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

D&A and capex are modeled as low-single-digit percentages of sales based on the company’s historical depreciation and cash capex profile. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Working capital (modeled using reported consolidated working capital) is assumed to run off as a percent of sales, supporting FCF conversion over the forecast period. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Medical cost trend and utilization risk can overwhelm rate updates, compressing EBIT margins below modeled recovery. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))

Government contracting / rate-setting changes (Medicaid and Medicare Advantage) could reduce premium revenue or delay margin normalization. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Liquidity, statutory capital constraints, or higher-than-expected cash outflows could limit flexibility and pressure returns. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001179929/000117992926000005/moh-20251231.htm))

Terminal assumptions (Gordon growth) and WACC are set to economically reasonable levels for a U.S. managed-care operator; bull/bear scenarios modestly shift growth/margins and discount rate. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1179929/000117992926000002/moh4q25_er.htm))
